Night Desk now has a real mark, tab icon, and document head — the chrome is a wordmark instead of leftover Next.js defaults.

**Mark.** A copper banker's lamp over a blotter. It reads at 16px in the tab and matches the navy/copper desk.

**In the product.** The header is the lamp + “Night Desk” in Newsreader, on the pipeline, thesis, deal, room, and preview pages.

**Document head.**
- Tab title: `Night Desk`, or `Thesis · Night Desk` / `{company} · Night Desk`
- Favicon (SVG + ICO) and Apple touch icon
- Open Graph / Twitter share card
- Theme color `#1e2a3a` and a web app manifest
- Unused create-next-app SVGs removed
